name: Urban Brand Ltd.
summary: Urban Brand Ltd, a real estate company initiates and establishes residential construction projects in Israel. The company engages in urban renewal and projects in the framework of evacuation construction and TAMA 38, an entrepreneurial, planning and executing company specializing in unique projects in the fields of urban renewal and land-based construction to improve earthquake resistance of buildings. Urban Brand Ltd was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Bnei Brak, Israel.
